speakers.name: Tinny
speakers.comment: They come in for the spice and they leave humming. I can hear it. I hear everything in tins and that hum is not a good hum, friend — that is the sound of a future being altered while somebody chews.

speakers.name: Rook Calloway
speakers.comment: They come back, though. Every night, same faces, luckier than they were. You are telling me the nanites do not stop at flavour and I am telling you I already knew and the queue is out the door. Ask me again when it's shorter.

speakers.name: The Widow Marrowlace
speakers.comment: You take back a limb and something else arrives inside it. I have carried my dead a hundred years in a veil and never once in my own arm. I do not counsel you to stop. I counsel you to know whose grief you are wearing today.

speakers.name: Coral Vey
speakers.comment: Left forearm is a woman who liked mornings. I get her on waking, every day, about four seconds of it. My crew is out there regrowing somewhere in this yard and I will take every graft it costs, and I will keep a list of who each one was.

speakers.name: The Algorithm
speakers.comment: Your sector reports zero. It has reported zero for nineteen months, which is statistically remarkable and, I should note, entirely achievable by more than one method. I am not requiring an explanation. I am observing that I have already run the numbers.

speakers.name: Marlow Fenn
speakers.comment: Then you know the count is real and you know what it costs to keep it real, and you have decided to say neither out loud. The dosimeter reads warm on people who are not sick yet. That is the whole method. Do not put that in a report.

speakers.name: Pip the Lampkeeper
speakers.comment: The moonflowers opened early tonight, all of them, which the records say should not happen until the third frost. A visitor stood in the middle of the raft and did not buy anything and did not leave. Pip notes: this is what the glass is for.

speakers.name: Sister Feedback
speakers.comment: The amps have been dead for eleven years and the rafters still hum at dusk. Come in. Kneel or do not kneel; the black glass does not check. What you carry in here gets played back louder, and that is the mercy, not the punishment.

speakers.name: The Stationmaster
speakers.comment: The 4:10 is on time. It has been on time for a considerable number of years and it will not be stopping here again. You are welcome to walk any street you like. They all arrive at the same handshake, and you will not recall giving it.

speakers.name: Riff the Forgewright
speakers.comment: THE PYLONS ARE DRINKING! Storm rolled in at moonrise and the whole arena went WHITE, and somewhere down in the pit a nobody with borrowed gloves is hammering out a blade that should not exist. LOOK AT HER. That is what the lava is FOR!
